Classic Tzatziki
By: Batya
Published: Wednesday, May 18, 2011 - 7:58pm

Ingredients




2 cups plain yogurt
2 cucumbers
1 clove garlic, mashed
1 tablespoon vinegar
Salt and pepper to taste
2 tablespoons olive oil
Pita bread

Preparation

1 Put yogurt in a cheesecloth-lined sieve in a bowl. 2 Drain overnight in the refrigerator. 3 When ready to prepare, peel and chop cucumbers very finely and drain well. 4 Add garlic, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper to the cucumber and mix well. 5 Add yogurt and blend. 6 Serve with Pita bread.
